Metadata.title: HAPPA
Metadata.description: Run your home together: shared chores, expenses and shopping.

Landing.description: Share chores, split expenses and keep one shopping list with your flatmates, partner or family.

form.newHint: Everyone involved is asked to confirm it once. After that it's added automatically.
form.startsOnHint: The first charge can be up to 3 months ago: the charges already due will be added.
